content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures asphalt, aggregate and mining equipment for road builders; no oil and gas reservoir business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Rents downhole drilling tools for drilling jobs; no reservoir analysis, perforating or production enhancement."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Distributes MRO industrial products and repairs plant pumps; not reservoir or well services."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors; unrelated to oil and gas services."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Provides production chemicals and well production optimization to the same upstream operators, overlapping with Core Lab's production enhancement."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pumps, valves and friction products for industrial and aerospace customers; not oilfield services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Operates midstream gathering, processing and pipelines earning transport fees; no reservoir services."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Rents and fabricates gas compressors for producers and midstream; equipment rental rather than reservoir analysis."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pre-insulated piping for district energy and projects; not reservoir or well services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Sells metalworking fluids and industrial lubricants to manufacturers; different customers and products."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Mines and transports frac sand as a proppant commodity; no reservoir description or analysis services."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Provides inspection, repair and heat treating for refineries and plants; not reservoir or well services."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Offers reservoir evaluation, well completion, production optimization and perforating-related tools to the same oil and gas operators."}]}
